A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.2.15
§ Adin = "dainty" or "delicate"
1) ancestor of a family of exiles who returned with Zerubbabel
2) a chief among the returned exiles who signed the covenant with Nehemiah

A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.11.42; 
son of: Shiza (H7877) 
§ Adina = "slender"
a chief of the Reubenites, and a captain of David

§ Adithaim = "double ornament"
a town in the lowland of Judah

A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.27.29; 
father of: Shaphat (H8202K) 
§ Adlai = "justice of Jehovah"
ancestor of Shaphat, the overseer of David's herds

Adullam = "justice of the people"
a town of the Canaanites allotted to Judah and lying in the lowlands; site of the cave where David hid
Also named: a.dul.la.mi (עֲדֻלָּמִי "Adullamite" H5726)

Someone from Adullam
Group of a.dul.lam (עֲדֻלָּם "Adullam" H5725) 
§ Adullamite, of Adullam "justice of the people"
an inhabitant of Adullam

§ Eden = "pleasure"
a place conquered by Assyria; probably located in the northwest of Mesopotamia
